description: This file defines the 'PerformanceTracker' entity class used in an HR management system, including properties, ORM annotations, and accessor methods.

classes.name: PerformanceTracker
classes.description: Entity class representing a performance tracker with properties such as id, name, dates, status, and references to employee entities and reviewers. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the performance tracker.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the performance tracker.

methods.name: getTrackerName
methods.description: Returns the name of the performance tracker.

methods.name: setTrackerName
methods.description: Sets the name of the performance tracker.

methods.name: getAddedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the performance tracker was added.

methods.name: setAddedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the performance tracker was added.

methods.name: getModifiedDate
methods.description: Returns the last modified date of the tracker, if any.

methods.name: setModifiedDate
methods.description: Sets the last modified date of the tracker.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the tracker (e.g., active, deleted).

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the tracker.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the employee associated with the tracker.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the employee associated with the tracker.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerReviewer
methods.description: Returns the collection of reviewers linked to this tracker.

methods.name: setPerformanceTrackerReviewer
methods.description: Sets the collection of reviewers for this tracker.

methods.name: getAddedBy
methods.description: Returns the employee who added the tracker.

methods.name: setAddedBy
methods.description: Sets the employee who added the tracker.
